newsitem.title: USA: NASD CEO sees successor named by year-end.
newsitem.headline: NASD CEO sees successor named by year-end.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers is likely to name a successor to president and chief executive Joseph Hardiman by the end of the year, Hardiman said on Friday.
Speaking at a press briefing at the Securities Industry Association's annual meeting, Hardiman said the NASD had narrowed the search to six candidates.
He said he expected the board to settle on one of the six "certainly by the end of the year."
Hardiman, who has no set retirement date, said he would stay on through any needed transition.
He declined to identify any of the finalists, noting that "all six are gainfully employed elsewhere."
